The owner then checked the administration view from an existing session and found an unfamiliar administrator changing network restrictions. The loss of access affects the whole team, but the new observation is that an unknown actor is actively changing our settings without permission. We have a separate routine invoice question that can wait. Please investigate the suspected takeover. We are intentionally not pasting access tokens or personal information into the ticket. We cannot establish exactly how the actor entered, so treat the attribution as uncertain; the unauthorized ongoing changes themselves are the observed event. The service-access failure and billing question should not obscure that active security concern.

rationale: Suspected active compromise has precedence over a service-wide outage.
